name: OVBench
intro: OVBench是一个综合性的问答基准测试，旨在评估模型在在线视频上下文中感知、记忆和推理的能力。它包含六种核心任务类型，涵盖过去、当前和未来的三种时间上下文，形成来自不同数据集的16个子任务。
org: Nanjing University, China Mobile Research Institute, OpenGVLab, Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: 源数据集整理, 人工时空问答标注, 干扰项生成与人工质检
task_type: 在线视频理解, 多项选择问答
eval_feature: 过去、当前与未来时间上下文, 滑动窗口与流式评测
scale: 1,463个视频, 约7,000条标注, 6类任务/16个子任务
build_method_en: Source-dataset Curation, Human Spatiotemporal QA Annotation, Distractor Generation and Human Review
eval_feature_en: Past, current, and future temporal contexts; sliding-window and streaming evaluation
intro_en: OVBench is a comprehensive question-answering benchmark designed to evaluate models' abilities in perception, memory, and reasoning within online video contexts. It includes six core task types covering past, present, and future temporal contexts, comprising 16 subtasks from various datasets.
scale_en: 1,463 videos, approximately 7,000 annotations, 6 task types and 16 subtasks

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.00584 and the official VideoChat-Online project. The diagrams preserve the past/current/future temporal-context definition; six task types and 16 subtasks; leakage-aware curation from six real-world domains; validation/test-only source splits; precise timestamp, bounding-box, trajectory, action, and object annotations; human-written task-specific QA; same-video cross-timestamp distractors; manual checks for question clarity, option ambiguity, and annotation accuracy; trimming at the earliest relevant frame; duration-proportional sampling and task balance; the paper release of 1,463 videos and about 7,000 annotations; 32-second sliding-window and full-stream modes at 2 FPS; and accuracy aggregation across capabilities. It is explicitly kept separate from the independently published OVO-Bench.
